step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts a data processing and analytics platform for insurance data (Intellect Fabric Data Service). The visual components consist of: 1) External actors on the left: 'DATA SOURCES' (cloud symbol), an agents/users icon (people symbol), and 'CONSUMERS' (monitor symbol). 2) Ingestion & Gateway: ELB receives data from DATA SOURCES and forwards it to the K8S cluster. 3) Compute Layer: K8S cluster hosting microservices (Keycloak, Jupyter, Kong) connected bidirectionally to Amazon MQ for message queuing. 4) Database & Storage: K8S connects via VPC Peering to MongoDB Atlas, with a direct logical connection also drawn to MongoDB Atlas. Additionally, RDS (PostgreSQL) and Redis (ElastiCache) are depicted as components on the board for API Gateway configuration, authentication, and session caching.

graph.name: Intellect Design Fabric Data Platform Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture showing ingestion from multiple data sources through ELB to Kubernetes (K8S), buffered via Amazon MQ, stored in MongoDB Atlas over VPC Peering, alongside RDS and Redis management services.
